items.title: DeepSeek App API — web search, file input and safety checks built into the API
items.summary: DeepSeek moves the tools behind its chat app into the API, so developers can rebuild the app with a few request flags.

items.title: Nathan Lambert — Jensen Huang's exit is a setback for US open models
items.summary: Interconnects' Nathan Lambert says Huang was the open-model ecosystem's protector, and that support will likely fade.

items.title: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0 — logpoints and network mocks for coding agents
items.summary: Chrome DevTools MCP 1.13.0 lets an agent add logging to a running page and fake its network responses, without editing the site's code.

items.title: deepseek-v3-jax — DeepSeek V3 in 190 lines of pure JAX
items.summary: deepseek-v3-jax rebuilds DeepSeek V3's key ideas in 190 lines of plain JAX that you can read in one sitting.

items.title: Plannotator — review your coding agent's plans and diffs in a browser
items.summary: Plannotator gives coding agents a browser review screen, so you mark up a plan or diff instead of arguing in chat.

items.title: WSJ: Nvidia backed buyers' loans — so they could keep buying its GPUs
items.summary: A WSJ report says Nvidia guaranteed its customers' loans so they could keep buying Nvidia GPUs.

items.title: EFF — AI wearables turn privacy into a problem for everyone nearby
items.summary: The EFF says always-on AI recording devices take away the privacy choices of everyone around the wearer.

items.title: No AI Slop Manifesto — AI engineers pledge to own what their agents ship
items.summary: A pledge from AI engineers: agents are useful, but passing on unreviewed output is slop.

items.title: Apple App Review — AI-made apps slow down music developers
items.summary: Vibe-coded apps are flooding the iOS music category, and established developers say App Review is stuck.

items.title: Antigravity /teamwork — Google's agent teams prove an open math conjecture
items.summary: Google Research reports what Antigravity's multi-agent /teamwork system has solved, and opens free access for 10,000 academics.

items.title: Claude outage — login failures, then API errors hit claude.ai and Claude Code
items.summary: Two back-to-back Claude incidents on 13 November locked users out, then broke the API and connectors.

items.title: Unsloth Dynamic v3.1 — Qwen3.8-27B GGUF quants gain 5-10% accuracy
items.summary: Unsloth's Dynamic v3.1 recipe makes the same-size Qwen3.8-27B GGUF files more accurate.

items.title: OpenAI disbands its robotics team — general models take over robot work
items.summary: OpenAI folded its robotics team into its main research and applied groups, betting that general models can run robots.

items.title: 600 JEPA world-model experiments — subgoals, not physics, limit planning
items.summary: A long hands-on study finds that a JEPA world model's planner, not its predictor, is the real bottleneck.

items.title: Gödel's notebooks — Claude finds 663 theorems in 1,009 shorthand pages
items.summary: Claude turned a slow, page-a-week reading of Gödel's private workbooks into a full catalogue of his unpublished theorems.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.325 — sandboxed Bash commands now ask for permission
items.summary: Claude Code 2.1.325 stops running sandboxed shell commands without a prompt unless you opt back in.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage — Copilot and AI connectors down for 20+ hours
items.summary: One Microsoft email failure broke Copilot and the Microsoft 365 tools inside Claude and ChatGPT at the same time.

items.title: Wes Roth — 'Gemini 4 Swarm is out of control...'
items.summary: Wes Roth tests Google's new Gemini 4 models and Antigravity /swarm, and lets Gemini 4 Carbon edit the video.

items.title: ChatGPT Wallet — OpenAI's agents can now buy things for you
items.summary: OpenAI gives its agents a way to pay, with a one-time-use card token and your approval on every order.

items.title: llama.cpp v1.0.0 — first stable release, with semantic versioning
items.summary: The local inference engine behind much of open-model AI makes its first stable release and promises clear version rules.

items.title: Transformers v5.23.0 — LFM3, Inkling 2 and a rebuilt model export
items.summary: Seven new model types and a new export API land in Hugging Face's model library.

items.title: ZONOS3-Mini — Zyphra's open TTS model clones voices in real time
items.summary: An Apache-2.0 speech model small enough to clone a voice in real time on a phone or in a browser tab.

items.title: Brave Search API — AI agents can now pay per request with x402
items.summary: Brave Search API lets an AI agent pay for each search with a stablecoin, with no account or API key.

items.title: Codex CLI 0.169.0 — side-chat tabs, task search and collapsible turns
items.summary: Codex CLI adds tabbed side chats, task search, collapsible transcripts and in-terminal provider setup.

items.title: OpenCode 2.3.0 — subagents run in the background by default
items.summary: OpenCode 2.3.0 makes subagents non-blocking and trims the transcript down to a quiet activity row.
